title: Annotated Gemini orbital photo #6: Arizona–Sonora border region
description: Black-and-white orbital terrain photograph on a white mount card, marked "#6" and oriented with "N" at top. Handwritten labels read "ARIZONA" at the top, "SONORA" at the bottom and "U.S. MEXICO" beside a dashed border line crossing the frame. A large irregular area near the center is outlined in ink.
